Package com.noorlandmc.NoorEntities.ai.beta.pathing

Class Navigator

java.lang.Object
com.noorlandmc.NoorEntities.ai.beta.pathing.Navigator
public class Navigator extends Object
Navigator
Steers a LivingEntity along an A*-planned path, one waypoint at a time. Works with any LivingEntity subtype (Player, ArmorStand, custom entities, etc.) since it drives movement purely through velocity — no mob-AI required.
Lifecycle: Navigator nav = new Navigator(plugin, entity, nodeMap); nav.onArrival(() -> ...); // optional nav.onFail(() -> ...); // optional nav.navigateTo(targetLoc); // begin nav.stop(); // cancel anytime
